Moderation response with multiple categories flagged

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ModerationRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ModerationRequest.from_json("{\"input\":\"Extremely harmful content targeting multiple categories\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}")
    result = await client.moderate(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
